(By Shri Sunil Gupta - Panel Lawyer)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.283/2023 dated 25.7.2023, registered at Police Station Nourajabad,
District Umariya (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 376(2)(cha), 336, 323 of IPC.

As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant - Haleem Khan is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
However, as prayed, applicant shall be at liberty to renew the prayer for grant of bail after recording of prosecutrix evidence before the trial court.
